prompt.shared: Quiet Celestial Storybook tarot illustration, warm hand-painted gouache and delicate ink texture on aged paper, the established recurring cast, gentle four-and-a-half-head human proportions, expressive faces and correct natural hands, one coherent physical scene, restrained dusty blue, indigo, plum, cream, ochre and small antique-gold accents, soft atmospheric light, portrait composition designed for a 5:7 crop, no border and no text.
prompt.negative: No title, numeral, caption, lettering, watermark, logo, signature, ornate card frame, photorealism, glossy 3D, chibi anatomy, oversized head, extra fingers, fused hands, duplicate person, floating symbol collage, neon glow, glitter, heart motif, or candy-color gradient.

cast.description: Medium-brown skin, short dark curls, open expression, and plum-and-cream clothing; keep the same facial structure and age as The Fool.
Deep-brown skin, long braids with small gold details, and blue-and-ochre clothing; keep the same facial structure and age as The Lovers.
Olive skin, short copper curls, and green-and-cream clothing; keep the same facial structure and age as The Lovers.
Older East Asian woman with a silver bob and indigo-and-ochre clothing; keep the same facial structure and age as The Star.

locations.description: A connected family of mountain paths, orchards, flowering thresholds, and cultivated fields built from pale stone, white flowers, and winding paths.
A connected hilltop observatory, moonlit library, water channel, and quiet courtyard using pale stone, indigo night, and restrained gold stars.
A connected warm workshop, council terrace, and sheltered interior using wood, pale stone, dusty blue cloth, ochre leather, and practical tools.

symbolGrammar: Symbols must be physical parts of the scene rather than floating icon collages.
Use paths for choice and progression, water for emotional movement, and tools or architecture for agency.
Use paired trees, birds, gates, or hands for reciprocity and decision.
Use one dominant tarot symbol and no more than two supporting symbols.

referencePolicy.instruction: Supply the approved reference files through referenced_image_paths. Use them only to preserve recurring character identity, body proportion, palette, material, line quality, and world continuity. Do not copy the reference card composition into the new card.

cards.name: The Fool
cards.gesture: The traveler takes one confident step toward the open path while looking ahead; a small natural dog stays close without becoming a mascot.
cards.emotionalMovement: Curious trust opening into movement while retaining awareness of the terrain.

cards.name: The Lovers
cards.gesture: The pair face each other at a garden threshold with mutually offered open hands and clear personal space.
cards.dominantSymbol: two paths joining at a garden threshold
cards.emotionalMovement: Deliberate reciprocity, visible choice, and connection without loss of individual agency.

cards.name: The Star
cards.gesture: The astronomer kneels beside the returning water channel and pours water from a simple vessel while watching the reflected light.
cards.emotionalMovement: Quiet renewal growing from modest, observable signs after a difficult passage.

cards.name: The Magician
cards.gesture: The maker stands at a warm wooden workbench, lifting one simple brass wand with one hand while the other open hand points toward four neatly arranged practical tools.
supportingSymbols: a looping linen cord resting on the table
cards.emotionalMovement: Focused intention becoming skilled, observable action through prepared tools and deliberate choice.

cards.name: The High Priestess
cards.gesture: The astronomer sits between two pale stone columns in a moonlit library, calmly opening a star chart across her lap while listening beside a narrow water channel.
cards.dominantSymbol: a crescent moon carved into the stone arch
cards.emotionalMovement: Still observation deepening into trustworthy intuition without forcing an immediate answer.

cards.name: The Empress
cards.gesture: The gardener stands in a cultivated orchard, holding a woven seed basket at waist height while inspecting healthy new growth with a grounded, attentive expression.
cards.emotionalMovement: Patient care becoming visible abundance while remaining connected to labor, seasons, and limits.

cards.name: The Emperor
cards.gesture: The maker stands at a civic terrace worktable, setting a square stone model onto a measured plan with both hands in a careful act of responsible construction.
cards.emotionalMovement: Clear boundaries and measured responsibility creating structure that others can trust.

cards.name: The Chariot
cards.gesture: The traveler stands securely in a small practical wooden chariot, holding two reins with calm control as a dark horse and a pale horse move together along the same road.
cards.emotionalMovement: Competing forces becoming coordinated direction through steadiness rather than speed or domination.

cards.name: Strength
cards.gesture: The gardener kneels beside a calm natural lion and gently wraps its injured front paw, keeping her hands visible and relaxed while the animal chooses to remain near.
supportingSymbols: a flowering vine forming one loose loop
cards.emotionalMovement: Fear and intensity settling into gentle courage, patience, and a boundary that protects both beings.

cards.name: The Hermit
cards.gesture: The astronomer walks alone along a high stone path at blue hour, holding a warm hooded lantern ahead with one hand and a plain walking staff with the other.
cards.emotionalMovement: Solitude becoming practical inner guidance, with enough light for the next step rather than the entire road.

cards.name: Wheel of Fortune
cards.gesture: The traveler pauses beside a large working waterwheel at a four-way civic crossing, one hand resting on a wooden rail while water turns the wheel through a changing sky.
cards.emotionalMovement: An uncontrollable cycle becoming readable enough for flexible timing and a different response.

cards.name: Temperance
cards.gesture: The traveler stands with one boot on a pale stone bank and one in a shallow water channel, slowly pouring a continuous stream between two simple vessels without spilling.
cards.emotionalMovement: Separate needs becoming a workable, patient balance through repeated small adjustments.
